notes:
Sourced primarily from Soundcraft's own official Vi3000 documentation (all hosted on soundcraft.com / Harman's adn.harmanpro.com asset server, linked from the product page): the Vi3000 User Guide v1.4 (rear-panel connector descriptions, text confirming Monitor A = LCR, Monitor B = LR, headphone impedance, AES/MADI/Dante behavior, GPIO-card-is-optional) and the official product brochure (high-res labeled rear-panel photograph used to verify exact port counts/labels: LINE OUT 1-16 / 17-24, MNTR.A L/R/C, MNTR.B L/R, MASTERS L/R/C, MIC/LINE IN 1-16 / 17-32, AES OUT/IN 1-2 & 3-4, MADI OUT/IN, Dante PRIMARY/SECONDARY, WORD CLOCK IN/OUT, MIDI IN/OUT, USB, HiQ, DVI OUT, dual MAINS INPUT with POWER switches).

Ports listed reflect the console's standard/most-commonly-shown configuration (32 local Mic/Line inputs + 32 total analogue outputs, i.e. 24 numbered Line Outs plus the fixed Monitor A/Monitor B/Master section). The two main local I/O card bays are factory-configurable to alternate layouts per the User Guide (e.g. 48 mic in/16 line out, or 16 mic in/16-in-16-out AES/16 line out), so a specific shipped unit's populated ports can differ from this list. Two D21m expansion slots are unpopulated as standard and accept optional cards (MADI Cat5/optical, ADAT, Blu Link, Aviom, EtherSound, CobraNet, AES/EBU, mic/line, or a GPIO D-sub card) — not included in the port list since nothing is fitted by default. An optional remote 64-channel analogue Stagebox (64 mic/line in, 32 line out) is sold separately and is not part of the console's own rear panel.

MADI connectors are multimode SC fiber per the User Guide text ("Connections are via multimode SC connectors"); "fiber-lc" was used as the closest available connector id since SC is not in the allowed list. No bandwidth/link-speed grade is published for the Dante or HiQnet EtherCon (RJ45) ports, so grade was omitted rather than guessed. The console is a large-format desktop control surface (~54kg per the User Guide specs page), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits was omitted.

ports.name: Mic/Line In 1-16
ports.note: Female XLR, individual 48V phantom per channel; part of factory-configurable local I/O card bay

ports.name: Mic/Line In 17-32
ports.note: Female XLR, individual 48V phantom per channel; part of factory-configurable local I/O card bay

ports.name: Talkback Mic In
ports.note: On console top panel/armrest area, not rear panel; switchable 48V phantom

ports.name: AES In 1-2
ports.note: 3-pin XLR AES/EBU, 2 channels, green lock/confidence LED

ports.name: AES In 3-4
ports.note: 3-pin XLR AES/EBU, 2 channels, green lock/confidence LED

ports.name: MADI In
ports.note: Actual connector is multimode SC fiber (closest available id used); shares active-input selection with Dante (only one of MADI/Dante input active at a time)

ports.name: Mains Input 1 (PSU1)
ports.note: IEC C13/14-style inlet, 100-240V auto-ranging; dual redundant PSU, either supplies full console

ports.name: Mains Input 2 (PSU2)
ports.note: IEC C13/14-style inlet, 100-240V auto-ranging; dual redundant PSU, either supplies full console

ports.name: Line Out 1-16
ports.note: Male XLR; feeds any of the console's 24 configurable output busses

ports.name: Line Out 17-24
ports.note: Male XLR; feeds any of the console's 24 configurable output busses

ports.name: Monitor A (L/R/C)
ports.note: Fixed-routing LCR monitor output, 3x male XLR

ports.name: Monitor B (L/R)
ports.note: Fixed-routing stereo monitor output, 2x male XLR

ports.name: Master (L/R/C)
ports.note: Fixed-routing LCR master output, 3x male XLR

ports.name: AES Out 1-2
ports.note: 3-pin XLR AES/EBU, 2 channels

ports.name: AES Out 3-4
ports.note: 3-pin XLR AES/EBU, 2 channels

ports.name: MADI Out
ports.note: Actual connector is multimode SC fiber (closest available id used); runs in parallel with Dante output

ports.name: Word Clock Out
ports.note: Outputs console wordclock at 48kHz

ports.name: DVI Out
ports.note: Listed by Soundcraft as "for future use"

ports.name: Headphones
ports.note: Socket under console armrest, 50-600 ohm

ports.name: Lamp Power Out (12V DC)
ports.note: x2 (left and right console corners), for gooseneck work lamps, 12V DC 1A

ports.name: Dante Primary
ports.note: Built-in Dante interface, 64x64ch; shares active input selection with local MADI

ports.name: Dante Secondary
ports.note: Built-in Dante interface redundant port

ports.name: HiQnet
ports.note: XLR-housed EtherCon connector for HiQnet control network

ports.name: MIDI In

ports.name: MIDI Out
ports.note: 5-pin DIN

ports.name: USB (Rear Panel)
